name: Infoblox — RPZ NXDOMAIN Block (Device C2 Attempt Blocked at DNS)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "Threat"
| filter infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log contains "RPZ-QNAME"
| alter src_ip = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        blocked_domain = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "qname=(\S+)"), 0)
| filter src_ip != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as rpz_nxd,
       count_distinct(blocked_domain) as distinct_domains,
       values(blocked_domain) as blocked_domains
       by src_ip, _time
| filter rpz_nxd >= 1
| fields src_ip, blocked_domains
description: Infoblox xdm.event.type = 'Threat' with RPZ-QNAME and NXDOMAIN — compromised device's first C2 lookup blocked at DNS layer.
alert_name: Infoblox — RPZ NXDOMAIN Block (Device C2 Attempt Blocked at DNS)
